title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Go to Symbol has its 200 slots back
summary: Hiding object expressions from search was done after the result cap, so on a real project a search for anon spent 199 of its 200 slots on them and showed one match where eleven exist.

highlights.title: Eleven matches, not one
highlights.description: A class whose name merely contains the letters you typed was cut by a cap already spent on entries that were then thrown away.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Object expressions are left out inside the search itself, ahead of the cap, the way local variables already were. A search for anon on a real Android project returned one result and now returns the eleven that match, MyAnonHelper among them.
Filtering by kind gained the same treatment: object: listed 85 singletons and now lists 98.
